title: Tether Flow
composition: Original wordless electronic facility loop, deterministic synthesis; no samples or artist imitation.
key: D minor with open ninths and suspended colors
arrangement: 8-bar motif repeated in four sections; restrained opening shaker, octave response in section three; two-bar sustained voicings, syncopated bass, half-time soft kick, dry rim and swung shaker.
mix: -20 LUFS target; periodic reverb/delay tails wrap across loop boundary. SFX occupy foreground.
